title: Add projection receipts and token accounting

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 projection-receipt and token-accounting capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse SupervisorTokenLedger@1 as the sole current-head Python-v1 token-accounting authority. It provides deterministic envelope-bound calibrated fallback estimates, content-derived identities, exact-once reconciliation, and dedicated positive and negative tests. No current-head package emits a PCSM compact-projection receipt binding a canonical slice, bounded alias/anchor decisions, exact PCSM source-map/tree identity, projection CID, and a complete token ledger. PCSM-046 independently established that the prerequisite projection builder is absent, and this receipt independently rechecked that absence at the current tree. Exact declared-output authority excludes the missing package and direct tests, so this receipt records a typed fail-closed unavailable/non-promotion disposition rather than creating a wrapper, a new receipt schema, or a competing token ledger.

freshness_check.method: Compared outer HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; compared every admitted superproject gitlink with nested HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; checked outer and admitted nested porcelain before receipt creation; calculated the scheduler and listed source/test SHA-256 values plus Git blobs; searched the accelerator agent_supervisor and required PCSM-test forests for PCSMProjectionBuilder, ProofCarryingSemanticProjectionBuilder, SourceLinkReceipt, PCSMTokenLedger, and PCSMProjectionReceipt; and inspected the direct non-PCSM projection and token-ledger candidates.
freshness_check.result: The bound outer head/tree and all four admitted gitlinks agree, and all checked worktrees were clean before the declared receipt write. Each exact PCSM package-name search returned zero matching Python files. Existing ProjectionReceipt is an explicitly non-authoritative DuckLake event-range record; SemanticProjectionStore persists caller-supplied opaque dataset references; neither is a PCSM compact-projection receipt. SupervisorTokenLedger@1 is the reusable accounting authority, but no PCSM-bound ProviderModelEnvelope, usage observation, calibration, or ledger instance was found.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any change to a bound outer commit/tree, admitted gitlink/head/tree, scheduler digest, listed source/test digest, search result, selected schema/version, or validation result requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree PCSM SourceLinkReceipt or canonical aggregate PCSM source-map CID exists. Git blobs, SHA-256 values, opaque federation content references, and caller-supplied tree IDs are not substitutes for that contract.

supervisor_token_ledger.selection: ipfs_accelerate_py.agent_supervisor.self_improvement.supervisor_token_ledger.ProviderModelEnvelope, TokenizerCalibrationSample, FallbackTokenizerCalibration, ProviderTokenUsage, TokenAttribution, and SupervisorTokenLedger
supervisor_token_ledger.determinism_and_cid_binding: Every selected record inherits CanonicalContract and has a content-derived identity. ProviderModelEnvelope binds provider, model, model revision, tokenizer, envelope revision, and context limit. A fallback calibration binds that envelope, calibration revision, and sorted source-free byte/token samples; estimate_bytes deterministically computes the ceiling of the calibrated byte/token ratio and identifies itself by calibration_id. SupervisorTokenLedger binds its ResultBinding, complete lifecycle population, terminal attributions, token attributions, and calibrations; claimed identities and derived report fields are recomputed and rejected on mismatch.
supervisor_token_ledger.measurement_boundary: Provider-native usage is measured only when supplied in ProviderTokenUsage. Calibrated fallback is explicitly estimated and requires the matching envelope-bound calibration. The ledger's authority-bound constants are false for provider settlement, usage authorization, correctness, and completion; token totals never become proof, mutation, validation, promotion, or completion authority.
supervisor_token_ledger.non_equivalence: The ledger does not accept a canonical PCSM semantic slice, bounded alias table, semantic-anchor decision, PCSM source-map CID, compact projection bytes/CID, or a PCSM projection receipt. It cannot mint a truthful current-PCSM ledger instance without a bound provider/model/tokenizer envelope, complete lifecycle events, terminal attributions, and measured usage or a calibration. It is reused only as the accounting authority, not relabelled as the missing projection receipt package.

ducklake_projection_receipt.behavior: A closed observational record of a DuckLake event-range projection with source root, tree ID, watermarks, checksum, cursor, and partition IDs. Its authoritative field is fixed false.
ducklake_projection_receipt.non_equivalence: It neither creates nor validates a PCSM semantic projection; it has no canonical slice, alias/anchor input, PCSM source-map CID, compact projection bytes/CID, token ledger, provider/model/tokenizer envelope, semantic proof, or promotion authority. Its source and direct tests are additionally unavailable to run in the sealed validation environment because importing the projection path requires the unavailable anyio dependency.

semantic_projection_store.behavior: It persists caller-supplied opaque datasets semantic-root and capsule identities under a federation tree binding, and rejects sibling paths and inconsistent bound identities.
semantic_projection_store.non_equivalence: It neither builds a compact PCSM projection nor issues a PCSM receipt. It has no PCSM slice, alias table, semantic-anchor policy, source-map CID, compact serializer/CID, or token accounting input. It cannot be upgraded to PCSM authority by its tree checks or opaque content references.

pcsm_018_validation_composition.meaning: A historical receipt-bound composition selecting datasets semantic-outcome, proof-carrying-artifact, assurance, sufficiency, MCP++ wire, and kit storage contracts for validation evidence.
pcsm_018_validation_composition.non_equivalence: The composition deliberately is not a second registered software-contract schema and does not construct ProofCarryingSemanticProjection@1, a source linker, a compact projection receipt, or a token ledger. Its prior tree observations are not reused as current identity evidence here.

dependency_receipt.currentness_rule: PCSM-046 is historical dependency context only. This receipt independently measured the current outer/nested identities, source files, absence searches, and sealed validation results.
dependency_receipt.result: The prerequisite PCSM projection builder remains absent at the bound current head, so there is no projection material from which the requested receipt and complete accounting instance could be derived.

existing_equivalents_assessed.authority_boundary: Canonical semantic identity remains datasets-owned; kit may store exact bytes/CIDs but does not decide projection semantics; a local alias never becomes canonical identity; model output is candidate-only. This receipt creates no builder, projection, source mutation, source-map/linker, token ledger, proof acceptance, validation acceptance, promotion, M2, M3, or completion authority.

capability_disposition.required_implementation: A versioned deterministic Python-v1 PCSM projection-receipt package that accepts only a current canonical semantic slice and the projection builder's bounded alias/semantic-anchor decisions; verifies exact tree and canonical PCSM source-map identities; emits deterministic compact projection bytes, canonical target relinking, projection CID, and a receipt that binds the builder/schema policy and a complete SupervisorTokenLedger instance. The ledger must name an exact provider/model/tokenizer envelope and distinguish provider-native measured from envelope-calibrated estimated token usage.
